prompt:
In `shelf/dates.py` add business-day helpers. Weekends are Saturday and Sunday; `holidays` is any iterable of `date`s (a list, set or generator).

`business_days_between(start, end, holidays=())`: the number of days `d` with `start < d <= end` that are weekdays and not holidays; 0 when `end <= start`.

`add_business_days(d, n, holidays=())`: the date `n` business days after `d`, skipping weekends and holidays; `n == 0` returns `d` unchanged (even on a weekend); a negative `n` raises `ValueError`.

Keep the existing tests passing (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
